class.name: GameplaySessionClient
class.brief_description: ENet client for the dedicated-server connection handshake.
class.description: GameplaySessionClient performs the GF-2 version, authentication, and join handshake. ENet does not encrypt the supplied credentials; use short-lived tokens and a suitable secure network boundary in production. This class is intentionally limited to connection bootstrap and does not provide gameplay RPCs, replication, relevancy, or prediction.

method.name: connect_to_server
method.description: Creates an ENet client and begins connecting.

method.name: get_multiplayer_peer
method.description: Returns the ENet peer while allocated.

method.name: get_peer_id
method.description: Returns the temporary ENet peer ID.

method.name: get_reconnect_token
method.description: Returns the opaque token supplied by successful authentication.

method.name: is_joined
method.description: Returns whether the server completed player spawning.

method.name: poll
method.description: Polls ENet and advances the handshake.

signal.name: state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the client handshake state changes.
